traits.name: Duergar Resilience.
traits.text: The duergar has advantage on saving throws against poison, spells, and illusions, and has resistance against poison damage.

traits.name: Innate Spellcasting.
traits.text: The duergar's innate spellcasting ability is Intelligence. It can innately cast fog cloud, jump, and enlarge/reduce (each 1/day).

actions.name: War Pick.
actions.text: Melee Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 6 (1d8 + 2) piercing damage, or 11 (2d8 + 2) if used with two hands to make a melee attack.

actions.name: Javelin.
actions.text: Melee or Ranged Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 30/120 ft. Hit: 5 (1d6 + 2) piercing damage.
